```{ojs}
readouts = FileAttachment("figures/readouts.json").json()
viewof readout = Inputs.radio(new Map([
  ["right on the default rows", "default_made_explicit"],
  ["answers fenced in a code block", "fenced"],
  ["answers over several lines", "multi_line"],
]), {value: "default_made_explicit", label: "Show"})
Plot.plot({
  width: Math.min(width, 640), height: 40 + 26 * readouts.data.length, marginLeft: 100, style: {fontSize: "13px"},
  x: {label: "% →", grid: true},
  y: {label: null, domain: readouts.data.map(d => names[d.model] ?? d.model)},
  marks: [
    Plot.barX(readouts.data.filter(d => d[readout] !== null), {x: d => 100 * d[readout], y: d => names[d.model] ?? d.model,
      fill: d => colors[d.model] ?? "#898781", tip: true, title: d => `${names[d.model] ?? d.model}: ${(100 * d[readout]).toFixed(1)}%`}),
    Plot.ruleX([0]),
  ],
})
```

::: {.caption}
Readouts on test-clean, never used to choose a checkpoint. Default rows: the rows where gold and a
baseline differ only by an optional argument written out at its default.
:::
